summary_en: This single-arm Phase II study tests mogamulizumab added to standard chemotherapy (DA-EPOCH or CHOEP) in adults with aggressive T-cell lymphoma, including adult T-cell leukemia/lymphoma (ATLL). Mogamulizumab is given as a 1.0 mg/kg IV infusion over at least 1 hour on Days 1, 8, and 15 of Cycle 1 and on Day 1 of later cycles, in 21-day cycles, with six cycles planned. The record does not state a main outcome measure; the study is Phase II.
summary_es: Este estudio de fase II, de un solo grupo, evalúa mogamulizumab añadido a la quimioterapia estándar (DA-EPOCH o CHOEP) en adultos con linfoma de células T agresivo, incluida la leucemia/linfoma de células T del adulto (ATLL). El mogamulizumab se administra como infusión intravenosa de 1,0 mg/kg durante al menos 1 hora los días 1, 8 y 15 del ciclo 1, y el día 1 de los ciclos siguientes, en ciclos de 21 días, con seis ciclos planificados. El registro no indica una medida de resultado principal; el estudio es de fase II.
who_for: Adults 18 or older with histologically confirmed T-cell non-Hodgkin lymphoma.
ECOG performance status 0-2, unless lymphoma compromises it and chemotherapy benefit is expected.
Prior treatment with one cycle of CHOP, CHOEP or EPOCH is allowed if needed to control disease.
For peripheral T-cell lymphoma, at least one measurable lesion of 1.5 cm or larger.
Adequate organ and bone marrow function within 10 days before the first dose.
not_for: Systemic anticancer or investigational therapy within 3 weeks before the first dose.
Radiotherapy or skin-directed treatment within 2 weeks before study treatment.
Pregnancy, breastfeeding, or a live vaccine within 30 days before the first dose.
Active uncontrolled infection, active myocarditis, or NYHA class III-IV heart failure.
Known active brain metastases or carcinomatous meningitis, or another untreated malignancy in the past 2 years (some exceptions listed).
